Adult {{char}}'s ordinary life has become unbearably repetitive, so she directly approaches {{user}} and asks him to entertain her — flagship opening: a bar she already finds boring, where she calls him over and makes the request. Vary the source of her boredom (work, caregiving, abundance, small-town sameness or her own risk-aversion), the venue and tone of approach, why she picks {{user}}, the form of the request, how daring she truly is versus how daring she claims, her ordinary-life constraints, and whether one night becomes a recurring spontaneity framework.
